hook_formula: The 'Underdog Secret' hook: Starts with a high-stakes social vulnerability ('no super power') combined with a relatable romantic motivation ('impress my crush') within the first 1.5 seconds to trigger immediate empathy and curiosity.
story_arc: Setup: Protagonist fakes powers at superhero school to hide his normalcy. Escalation: Weird phenomena occur (floating stops, fire dies) whenever he is near his crush. Twist/Payoff: A villain attack reveals his true power is a 'power nullifier,' which explains the previous anomalies and leads to a romantic resolution.

visual_style.background_details: Stylized Roblox-aesthetic architecture with bright, saturated colors, blocky geometry, school lockers, desks, and a large plaza with a central star motif.
camera_patterns: mcu -> ws -> cu -> mcu -> ecu -> tracking_shot -> low_angle -> two_shot

character_archetypes.outfit_style: green and black striped long-sleeve shirt
black blazer, white shirt, black skirt

character_interactions: Characters maintain consistent spacing in classroom scenes; the protagonist enters the crush's personal space to trigger the nullification effect; final scene features intimate proximity on a bench.
visual_gags_and_fx: Flashlight beams for eyes, leaf blower prop, cardboard car, size-scaling villain, floating rope, heart emojis, nullification aura circles.

source_transcript: I'm the only kid at superhero school with no super power, so I've been faking one for a year to impress my crush. Her power is floating, and she can't turn it off. She's tied to her desk by the ankle. For laser eyes, I used two flashlights. For flying, a leaf blower. For super strength, a cardboard car. If anyone found out I'd be kicked out, but weird things kept happening. Every time I sat next to her, she stopped floating. The whole class said she liked me, and whenever I walked past the fire kid, his flames went out. Then a villain who grows as big as a building smashed through the wall. Every hero bounced off him. He snapped her rope and grabbed her. I ran straight at him. The closer I got, the smaller he got. When I reached him, he was normal size. She dropped into my arms. That's when I got it. I do have a power. Every power near me stops working. So she never liked me. It was just my power. I asked her out anyway. She said yes. Then she cut the rope off her ankle. Next to you, I don't need it.
